reporterLines: Inventory Stock Aggregation & Lifecycle Contracts (#125)
Pure Aggregation Logic (computeItemStockAggregation)
√ 1. Zero stock fixture: no lots or 0 quantity yields usableStock=0, isOutOfStock=true, isLowStock=false (1 ms)
√ 2. Positive stock below threshold: usableStock=15, reorderPoint=20 yields isLowStock=true, isOutOfStock=false
√ 3. Positive stock at threshold: usableStock=20, reorderPoint=20 yields isLowStock=true (at or below threshold)
√ 4. Positive stock above threshold: usableStock=30, reorderPoint=20 yields isLowStock=false, isOutOfStock=false
√ 5. Missing value: lot with null currentQuantity is not treated as zero; yields hasMissingQuantity=true and usableStock=null (1 ms)
√ 6. All-expired lots: yields usableStock=0, isOutOfStock=true, hasExpired=true with separate expiredStock
√ 7. Mixed lots: both low-stock / out-of-stock and expired conditions remain visible without precedence masking (1 ms)
√ 7b. Mixed known and unknown usable lots: 0 + null does not assert isOutOfStock
√ 7c. Positive known stock below threshold with uncounted lots: isUsableStockSubtotal=true and isLowStock=true (uncertain low stock)
√ 7d. Positive known stock above threshold with uncounted lots: isLowStock=false (known stock alone is sufficient)
HTTP Endpoints & Zero Side-Effects Contracts
√ 8. GET /api/inventory/alerts is pure and produces ZERO database mutation side-effects (5 ms)
√ 9. GET /api/inventory/fefo/:itemId filters out expired lots from recommendations (4 ms)
√ 10. GET /api/inventory/alerts includes items with no lots as OUT_OF_STOCK and counts them in lowStock (#125) (3 ms)
√ 11. Expired lots produce both OUT_OF_STOCK and EXPIRED alerts without masking (#125) (2 ms)
√ 12. Missing quantities produce MISSING_QUANTITY alerts without asserting false OUT_OF_STOCK (#125) (2 ms)
√ 13. Production replica (124 no-lot + 2 expired-lot items): getItems and getAlerts match exactly at 126 out-of-stock (#125) (13 ms)
√ 14. Lab scoping in getAlerts and getItems: respects role scope correctly (#125) (4 ms)
√ 15. Multi-lot items: banner chip counts match unique affected item rows while preserving per-lot alert details (#125) (5 ms)
